note: Phase 6 rung 1 PILOT. Robit fitted family (Student-t link, free tail parameter r = 1/nu on [0, 0.5]) crossed with an MI design over (mu, sigma, r). Pilot tier: its job is to choose the r-axis resolution from its own refinement ladder and to time a cell, so that manuscript/phase6_protocol.md can be frozen with replicate counts derived from measured cost rather than guessed. No number it produces is confirmatory; coverage SE at 6 replicates is up to 0.20.

_tier.confirmatory_counts: not proposed here; see manuscript/phase6_protocol.md section 6, frozen against the timing this run records

fitted_family: probit (513^2 reference, DEC-7 production setting, unchanged)
robit (257^2 x n_r reference over (mu, log sigma, r))
design: mi2 = EntropyVectorPolicy over (mu, sigma), Rotem's, N = 10,000 with rejuvenation
mi3 = the same policy over (mu, sigma, r), N = 40,000 without rejuvenation
_arms.separability: fitted family and design are crossed, never bundled: (robit fit, mi2) isolates the widening effect and (probit fit, mi3) isolates the design effect. Both fits are applied to the same history, so the family contrast is paired within a replicate.

_dgps.probit: cost arm - the premium paid when the family is enlarged but the probit is true
_dgps.robit_1.0: truth approximately nested in the fitted family - should be repaired
_dgps.tail_1.0: truth outside the t family (asymmetric upper perturbation against a symmetric link) - partial repair at best, and the shortfall is a finding
